# Divine Nails and Spa

> Nails & spa based in Round Rock, Texas. Dip, gel, ombre, hand-painted nail art, pedicures and waxing at a small, family-owned salon on W Grimes Blvd. Regulars have been coming back for years.

- Phone: (512) 218-5965
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Georgetown, Hutto, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, North Austin
- Google rating: 4.4 from 187 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/divine-nails-and-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/divine-nails-and-spa/book.html

## Services
- Nail art: Swirls, lines, leaves, webs and rhinestones, painted by hand.
- Ombre & bridal sets: Soft ombre for bachelorettes, brides and the whole party.
- Dip powder: Neutral or bright dip that holds up without chipping.
- Gel polish: Glossy gel color, from classic red to pastel.
- Manicures: Clean, thorough manicures with cuticle care.
- Pedicures & waxing: Relaxing pedicures in massage chairs, plus waxing services.

## About
Divine Nails and Spa is a small, family-owned nail salon at 1500 A W Grimes Blvd in Round Rock. Clients describe very nice people, reasonable prices and work that lasts: one regular says her dip manicures never chip, crack or break. Many of our regulars have been coming for years, and some tried four other salons in the area before deciding this is the only one they'll go to. Clients ask for Katherine by name, for everything from a simple neutral dip to bachelorette ombre. The same group of women has worked here for years, led by owner Michelle. Anne is known for long, relaxing pedicures and Hannah for detailed hand-painted designs. The salon had a makeover last year, and there's usually a cooking or travel show on the TV while you wait. Every set on this site is real work from our chairs: hot pink swirls, spider webs, lavender leaves, mint, red and neon yellow. Bring a photo or an idea and we'll paint it on.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 10 am to 7 pm, Saturday 10 am to 6 pm. Closed Sundays.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Appointments are best. Call (512) 218-5965 and we'll find you a time; regulars say a quick call often gets them in the same day.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 1500 A W Grimes Blvd, Suite 125, Round Rock, TX 78664, on the W Grimes Blvd strip.
- Q: Do you do bridal and bachelorette nails?
  A: Yes. Clients have come in for bachelorette ombre and come back for bridal nails with family and friends. Call ahead for a group so we can save chairs together.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo or describe it: swirls, lines, leaves, webs, rhinestones or any color.
- Q: Do you do kids' nails?
  A: Yes. Kids' pedicures and manicures are welcome, and we've painted full nail-art sets for teens. Call ahead so we can set aside the time.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Credit cards and Apple Pay are accepted, and clients mention paying with Venmo, Cash App and Zelle. Call to confirm current payment options.
